entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: A gothic plane of humans, vampires, werewolves, geists, ghouls and demons, with four provinces and a Church of Avacyn.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: A vampire planeswalker, grandson of Edgar Markov, who created the archangel Avacyn to protect humanity and was branded a traitor by his kin.

entities.name: Edgar Markov
entities.description: Forefather of Innistrad's vampires who inflicted vampirism on his grandson Sorin.

entities.name: Shilgengar
entities.description: A demon on Innistrad's surface who prodded Edgar Markov into creating vampirism and became a harbinger of his kind.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: The archangel created by Sorin to safeguard humanity; she imprisoned demons in the Helvault and was herself drawn into it.

entities.name: Griselbrand
entities.description: The most powerful demon of Innistrad, worshipped by the Skirsdag cult, who challenged Avacyn and was driven into the Helvault.

entities.name: Mikaeus
entities.description: The Lunarch of the Church who witnessed Avacyn's battle with Griselbrand.

entities.name: The Helvault
entities.description: A huge mass of silver said to be a piece of Innistrad's silver moon, holding imprisoned demons and Avacyn, in Thraben Cathedral yard.

entities.name: The Silver Collar
entities.description: A collar of silver forged by Avacyn to bind demonkind; her symbol and the holy symbol of Avacynian priests and cathars.

entities.name: The Church of Avacyn
entities.description: The faith that grew up around Avacyn.

entities.name: The Skirsdag
entities.description: A demon-worshipping cult that worships Griselbrand.

entities.name: Thraben
entities.description: Innistrad's most holy city, whose cathedral yard holds the Helvault.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A deathmage planeswalker who surrendered her soul to four demon lords and came to Innistrad to hunt Griselbrand.

events.summary: Edgar Markov, prodded by the demon Shilgengar, creates vampirism on Innistrad and inflicts it on his grandson Sorin, awakening Sorin's planeswalker spark.
events.quote: Edgar inflicted his curse of vampirism on his grandson, Sorin, awakening Sorin's latent planeswalker spark.

events.summary: Sorin returns to Innistrad after centuries and creates the archangel Avacyn to safeguard humanity.
events.quote: He created the archangel Avacyn to safeguard humanity

events.summary: Avacyn and her angels slaughter vampires, werewolves, geists and ghouls; Sorin's kin brand him a traitor.
events.quote: They slew vampires with holy fervor, prompting Sorin's kin to brand him a traitor to their kind.

events.summary: With the monsters in retreat, demons and devils manifest in greater numbers; Avacyn defeats them one by one and forges the Silver Collar to bind them.
events.quote: She then forged a collar of silver to bind demonkind

events.summary: Avacyn and her angels imprison the captured demons in the Helvault.
events.quote: imprisoning them in a huge mass of silver that came to be called the Helvault

events.summary: The demon Griselbrand lands on the Helvault under a full moon and challenges Avacyn to combat.
events.quote: he landed on the Helvault itself, under a full moon, and challenged Avacyn to combat

events.summary: After days of battle Avacyn drives Griselbrand into the Helvault; he impales her heart with his spear, and the backlashing binding spell draws her into the Helvault too.
events.quote: Avacyn was drawn into the Helvault herself.

events.summary: With Avacyn gone, holy wards fail, her angels dwindle and evil creatures grow bolder, causing a crisis of faith across Innistrad.
events.quote: Holy wards failed and prayers to Avacyn went unanswered.

relations.quote: He created the archangel Avacyn to safeguard humanity
Edgar inflicted his curse of vampirism on his grandson, Sorin

relations.note: They battled for days; both ended in the Helvault.
relations.quote: Avacyn and Griselbrand battled for days

relations.note: Griselbrand is hidden inside the Helvault.
relations.quote: the demon is hidden away inside a massive chunk of moon-silver

relations.note: Liliana surrendered her soul to Griselbrand and came to hunt him.
relations.quote: He's the demon that Liliana came to Innistrad to hunt down and, ideally, kill.
an ancient and powerful demon worshipped by the Skirsdag cult
